texto: {"findings":[{"tipo":"GPU","causa_raiz":"Sobrecarga massiva na GPU registrando pico de 26.38ms (117 violacoes contra o teto de 16.7ms para 60 FPS). Com draw calls controlados em 904, o gargalo decorre de alto custo por pixel/fragment shader, fill-rate elevado (overdraw), resolucao de renderizacao nativa sem escalonamento dinamico e configuracoes de sombras/pos-processamento agressivas para a GTX 1650.","codigo_refatorado":"using UnityEngine;\\n\\npublic class AdaptiveQualityController : MonoBehaviour\\n{\\n    [Header(\"Alvos de Desempenho\")]\\n    [SerializeField] private float targetFrameTimeMs = 16.6f;\\n    [SerializeField] private float toleranceMs = 1.5f;\\n\\n    [Header(\"Limites de Render Scale\")]\\n    [SerializeField] private float minRenderScale = 0.65f;\\n    [SerializeField] private float maxRenderScale = 1.0f;\\n    [SerializeField] private float scaleStep = 0.05f;\\n\\n    private float currentScale = 1.0f;\\n    private float accumulatedDeltaTime = 0f;\\n    private int frameCounter = 0;\\n    private const int EVALUATION_INTERVAL = 30;\\n\\n    private void Awake()\\n    {\\n        QualitySettings.vSyncCount = 0;\\n        Application.targetFrameRate = 60;\\n        ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers(currentScale, currentScale);\\n    }\\n\\n    private void Update()\\n    {\\n        accumulatedDeltaTime += Time.unscaledDeltaTime;\\n        frameCounter++;\\n\\n        if (frameCounter >= EVALUATION_INTERVAL)\\n        {\\n            float avgFrameTimeMs = (accumulatedDeltaTime / frameCounter) * 1000f;\\n            AdjustRenderingLoad(avgFrameTimeMs);\\n\\n            accumulatedDeltaTime = 0f;\\n            frameCounter = 0;\\n        }\\n    }\\n\\n    private void AdjustRenderingLoad(float avgFrameTimeMs)\\n    {\\n        if (avgFrameTimeMs > targetFrameTimeMs + toleranceMs)\\n        {\\n            if (currentScale > minRenderScale)\\n            {\\n                currentScale = Mathf.Max(minRenderScale, currentScale - scaleStep);\\n                ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers(currentScale, currentScale);\\n            }\\n            else if (QualitySettings.shadowDistance > 25f)\\n            {\\n                QualitySettings.shadowDistance = Mathf.Max(25f, QualitySettings.shadowDistance - 15f);\\n            }\\n        }\\n        else if (avgFrameTimeMs < targetFrameTimeMs - toleranceMs)\\n        {\\n            if (QualitySettings.shadowDistance < 60f)\\n            {\\n                QualitySettings.shadowDistance = Mathf.Min(60f, QualitySettings.shadowDistance + 5f);\\n            }\\n            else if (currentScale < maxRenderScale)\\n            {\\n                currentScale = Mathf.Min(maxRenderScale, currentScale + scaleStep);\\n                ScalableBufferManager.ResizeBuffers(currentScale, currentScale);\\n            }\\n        }\\n    }\\n}","explicacao_didatica":"A placa de video (GPU) esta demorando 26.38ms para desenhar cada quadro, o que limita o jogo a cerca de 37 FPS em vez dos 60 FPS desejados (16.7ms). Esse script atua como um 'piloto automatico': ele mede o tempo medio dos quadros e, quando percebe que a GPU esta sobrecarregada, reduz sutilmente a resolucao interna de renderizacao (Dynamic Resolution) e a distancia das sombras. Isso alivia instantaneamente a placa de video sem exigir retrabalho visual dos artistas."},{"tipo":"GC","causa_raiz":"Alocacao continua de memoria gerenciada acumulando cerca de 33.7 KB por quadro, provocando disparos frequentes do Garbage Collector que causam pequenos engasgos (stuttering) e variacao de frametime na CPU.","codigo_refatorado":"using UnityEngine;\\n\\npublic class NonAllocPhysicsSystem : MonoBehaviour\\n{\\n    [SerializeField] private LayerMask targetMask;\\n    [SerializeField] private float scanRadius = 15f;\\n\\n    private readonly Collider[] hitBuffer = new Collider[64];\\n    private readonly RaycastHit[] raycastBuffer = new RaycastHit[16];\\n\\n    public int QuerySurroundings(Vector3 origin)\\n    {\\n        int hitCount = Physics.OverlapSphereNonAlloc(origin, scanRadius, hitBuffer, targetMask);\\n        for (int i = 0; i < hitCount; i++)\\n        {\\n            ProcessTarget(hitBuffer[i]);\\n        }\\n        return hitCount;\\n    }\\n\\n    public bool CheckSightLine(Vector3 origin, Vector3 direction, float distance, out RaycastHit nearestHit)\\n    {\\n        int hitCount = Physics.RaycastNonAlloc(origin, direction, raycastBuffer, distance, targetMask);\\n        if (hitCount > 0)\\n        {\\n            nearestHit = raycastBuffer[0];\\n            return true;\\n        }\\n        nearestHit = default;\\n        return false;\\n    }\\n\\n    private void ProcessTarget(Collider targetCollider)\\n    {\\n        // Logica de processamento sem instanciacoes de memoria temporaria\\n    }\\n}","explicacao_didatica":"Em C#, metodos como Physics.RaycastAll ou instanciar listas a cada frame criam dados descartaveis na memoria RAM. Quando essa memoria enche, o Garbage Collector congela o jogo para limpar o lixo. Trocamos metodos que geram lixo por versoes NonAlloc com arrays pre-alocados (reutilizaveis), eliminando completamente as pausas de coleta de memoria."}],"dicas_level_design":null}
